chapters.title: Proclaim the Gospel, Confound Enemies
chapters.synopsis: The Lord calls Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon to lay aside the Bible translation and preach in the surrounding regions. They are to allay unkind feelings stirred up by apostate letters, confounding their enemies by declaring the truth openly.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Joseph and Sidney called to proclaim and defend the gospel

chapters.title: A Bishop Called in Kirtland
chapters.synopsis: Newel K. Whitney is appointed bishop for the Kirtland area. The Lord outlines the bishop's duties over the storehouse and the stewardships of the elders, requiring an account of every steward.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Newel K. Whitney called as bishop; duties of stewardship

chapters.title: Return to the Translation
chapters.synopsis: After weeks of preaching, Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon are told to resume the inspired translation of the Bible. They are to continue preaching only until the conference, then labor on the scriptures again.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Resume the inspired translation of the scriptures

chapters.title: Little Children Are Holy
chapters.synopsis: The Lord explains Paul's words about believing and unbelieving marriage partners. Little children are holy, sanctified through the atonement of Jesus Christ, and do not need the law of circumcision.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Explanation of 1 Corinthians 7:14; children are holy

chapters.title: Missionaries Sent Two by Two
chapters.synopsis: At a conference in Amherst, Ohio, the Lord calls many elders on missions, pairing them companion by companion. He promises that those who are faithful will be laden with sheaves and instructs the church to support missionaries' families.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Elders called two by two to proclaim the gospel

chapters.title: The Vision of Three Glories
chapters.synopsis: While pondering the resurrection, Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon see a vision of the Savior at the right hand of God and bear record that he lives. They behold the fall of Lucifer, the fate of the sons of perdition, and the celestial, terrestrial, and telestial kingdoms of glory.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord promises to reveal mysteries to the faithful

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The vision of the Son: he lives

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Fall of Lucifer and the sons of perdition

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The celestial glory described

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The terrestrial glory described

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The telestial glory described

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Great things seen, unlawful to utter

chapters.title: Keys to John's Revelation
chapters.synopsis: In a series of questions and answers, the Lord explains symbols from the book of Revelation. The beasts, the sealed book, the seven seals, and the earth's seven thousand years of temporal existence are unfolded.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Questions and answers on the book of Revelation

chapters.title: A Storehouse for the Poor
chapters.synopsis: The Lord directs the organization of a united firm to manage the storehouse and publishing concerns for the poor. He who receives all things with thankfulness shall be made glorious, for the earth and its fulness are the Lord's.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: An order established for the storehouse and the poor

chapters.title: A Mission to the East
chapters.synopsis: Jared Carter is called to preach the gospel in the eastern countries in the power of his ordination. The Comforter will teach him truth, and if faithful he will be crowned with sheaves.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Jared Carter called to the eastern countries

chapters.title: You Cannot Go Amiss
chapters.synopsis: Stephen Burnett is called to preach with Eden Smith as his companion. The Lord tells them to go north or south, east or west, for they cannot go amiss, declaring the things they have heard and believed.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Preach wherever you go; you cannot go amiss

chapters.title: A Counselor in the Presidency
chapters.synopsis: A counselor is called to hold the keys of the kingdom with Joseph Smith in the Presidency of the High Priesthood. He is to be faithful in counsel, pray always, and succor the weak and lift up the hands which hang down.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A counselor called; succor the weak

chapters.title: Where Much Is Given
chapters.synopsis: In Zion the Lord commands the leading elders to forgive one another and binds them in a united order for the benefit of the poor. Unto whom much is given much is required, and the Lord is bound when we do what he says.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Forgive one another; a covenant order for the poor

chapters.title: Caring for Widows and Children
chapters.synopsis: The Lord sets the order for supporting families in Zion. Women and children have claim upon their husbands and fathers, and widows and orphans have claim upon the church and the storehouse.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Families, widows, and orphans have claim on the storehouse

chapters.title: The Oath and Covenant of Priesthood
chapters.synopsis: The Lord reveals the lineage of the priesthood from Adam through Moses and explains the oath and covenant that belongs to it. Those who receive the priesthood and magnify their callings receive all that the Father has, and the elders are charged to preach the gospel to every creature.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Priesthood lineage; the oath and covenant

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Live by every word of God; the missionary charge

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Practical instructions for traveling ministers

chapters.title: One Mighty and Strong
chapters.synopsis: In a letter to Zion, the Lord's word directs that the clerk keep a record of those who consecrate and receive inheritances. Those not found on the book of the law of God shall have no inheritance, and one mighty and strong will set in order the house of God.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Keep the record of inheritances in Zion

chapters.title: The Wheat and the Tares
chapters.synopsis: The Lord explains the parable of the wheat and the tares: the tares must ripen before the field is burned, and the wheat is gathered first. The elders are lawful heirs of the priesthood, hidden with Christ, and their priesthood shall remain through their lineage.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Parable of wheat and tares; heirs of the priesthood

chapters.title: Prophecy on War
chapters.synopsis: Joseph Smith receives a prophecy that war will shortly come to pass, beginning at the rebellion of South Carolina. War will be poured out upon all nations until a full end of all nations, and the saints are told to stand in holy places and be not moved.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Wars foretold, beginning with South Carolina

chapters.title: The Olive Leaf
chapters.synopsis: Called the olive leaf plucked from the Tree of Paradise, this revelation teaches that the light of Christ fills the immensity of space and governs all things. The Lord unfolds the order of the resurrections and the Second Coming, and commands the saints to organize a school of the prophets and build a house of God.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The light of Christ fills the immensity of space

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Resurrections, the Second Coming, and the parable of the kingdoms

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A house of God and the school of the prophets

chapters.title: The Word of Wisdom
chapters.synopsis: The Lord gives a word of wisdom for the temporal salvation of the saints, counseling against wine, strong drink, tobacco, and hot drinks. Wholesome herbs, grains, and fruits are ordained for man's use, and those who obey are promised health, wisdom, and protection from the destroying angel.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A principle with promise for the saints' health

chapters.title: Oracles for the First Presidency
chapters.synopsis: The keys of the kingdom are confirmed upon Joseph Smith, and his counselors are appointed to be accounted as equal with him in holding the keys of this last dispensation. The oracles are to be given through him to the church, and the gospel is to go to all nations.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Keys of the kingdom; the Presidency established

chapters.title: Concerning the Apocrypha
chapters.synopsis: As Joseph Smith works on the Bible translation, the Lord tells him it is not needful to translate the Apocrypha. It contains many true things and many interpolations of men, and whoever reads it with the Spirit shall obtain benefit.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Apocrypha: true things and interpolations of men

chapters.title: Received into the Order
chapters.synopsis: Frederick G. Williams is received into the united order and told to be a lively member. The Lord promises that as he is faithful in keeping the commandments, he will be blessed forever.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A new member received into the united order

chapters.title: Light, Truth, and Intelligence
chapters.synopsis: The Lord declares that all who forsake sin and come unto him shall see his face and know that he is. Quoting the record of John, he teaches that Christ received grace for grace until he received a fulness, that intelligence is the glory of God, and that truth and intelligence were not created.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The glory of God is intelligence; grace for grace

chapters.title: Houses for the Work of God
chapters.synopsis: The Lord gives directions for building up Kirtland as a stake of Zion. A house for the Presidency and a house for printing the scriptures are to be built on dedicated lots, kept holy and undefiled.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Houses commanded for the Presidency and for printing

chapters.title: Chastened for the Temple Delay
chapters.synopsis: The Lord chastens the saints for neglecting to build the house in Kirtland, for whom he loves he also chastens. He renews the commandment, promising to endow his servants with power from on high, and reveals the pattern of the building.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Build my house; whom I love I chasten

chapters.title: Order of the Kirtland Stake
chapters.synopsis: The Lord directs the division of the Kirtland farm, appointing Newel K. Whitney to take charge of the place for the stake of Zion. Part of the land is set apart for the literary firm, and John Johnson is received into the order.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The stake strengthened; stewardship over the farm

chapters.title: Zion Must Be Pure in Heart
chapters.synopsis: The Lord approves the school of the elders in Zion and commands a temple to be built in Independence. Zion is the pure in heart; if she does what the Lord commands she shall escape, but otherwise sore affliction awaits.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Zion, the pure in heart, must build a house

chapters.title: Renounce War, Proclaim Peace
chapters.synopsis: As persecution rises in Missouri, the Lord counsels the saints to be patient in affliction and to befriend constitutional law. He gives the law of forgiveness toward enemies, commanding his people to renounce war and proclaim peace, bearing offenses and forgiving even repeated wrongs.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Be patient in affliction; forgive your enemies

chapters.title: Called to the Eastern Countries
chapters.synopsis: John Murdock is called to proclaim the everlasting gospel in the eastern countries. Whoever receives him receives the Lord, and after his children are provided for he is to go up unto the land of Zion.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: John Murdock called to proclaim the gospel

chapters.title: Your Families Are in My Hands
chapters.synopsis: While Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon preach in New York, the Lord assures them that their families are well and in his hands. He promises to give them in the very hour what to say, and declares that Zion shall be redeemed though she is chastened for a little season.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: It shall be given you what to say

chapters.title: Why Zion Was Scattered
chapters.synopsis: After the saints are driven from Jackson County, the Lord explains that they were afflicted because of their transgressions, yet he will own them and Zion shall not be moved out of her place. In the parable of the nobleman and the olive trees he shows why the watchmen failed, and he commands the saints to continue gathering and to seek redress from judges and rulers.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Zion chastened, yet her redemption is sure

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Parable of the nobleman and the olive trees

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Continue the gathering; importune for redress

chapters.title: The First High Council
chapters.synopsis: Minutes record the organization of the first high council of the church at Kirtland. Procedures are set for trying difficult cases, appointing councilors to speak, and rendering decisions in righteousness under the president's direction.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Minutes: the first high council organized

chapters.title: The Redemption of Zion
chapters.synopsis: The Lord explains why the saints were driven from Jackson County and promises that the redemption of Zion will come by power. Joseph Smith is directed to gather the strength of the Lord's house, and volunteers are recruited for the camp that will march to Missouri.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Zion's redemption by power; gather the camp

chapters.title: The United Order Reorganized
chapters.synopsis: The Lord reorganizes the united order, assigning individual stewardships to its members. The earth is full and there is enough and to spare, but the abundance must be imparted to the poor through the Lord's storehouse and treasury.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Stewardships assigned; the earth is full, and to spare

chapters.title: Wait for a Little Season
chapters.synopsis: On Fishing River the Lord tells Zion's Camp that Zion's redemption must wait for a little season until the elders are endowed with power in the house at Kirtland. The saints are to sue for peace and grow in favor until the armies of Israel become very great.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Zion's redemption deferred; the camp to disband

chapters.title: Gird Up Your Loins to Preside
chapters.synopsis: Warren A. Cowdery is called to preside over the church in the Freedom, New York, area. The Lord promises grace and assurance to those who humble themselves, for the coming of the Lord overtakes the children of light as a thief in the night no more.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A presiding officer called; children of the light

chapters.title: Order of the Priesthood Quorums
chapters.synopsis: This great revelation on priesthood sets forth the Melchizedek and Aaronic priesthoods and the presiding quorums of the church: the First Presidency, the Twelve, and the Seventy. It traces the order of the priesthood from Adam and details the duties of every office, charging all to learn their duty and act in all diligence.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Two priesthoods and the presiding quorums

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Duties of the offices; let every man learn his duty

chapters.title: Strengthen Your Brethren
chapters.synopsis: Lyman Sherman's sins are forgiven, and he is told to resist no more the voice of the Lord. He is promised a place among his brethren and charged to strengthen them in all his conversation, prayers, and doings.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Sins forgiven; strengthen your brethren

chapters.title: Dedication of the Kirtland Temple
chapters.synopsis: Joseph Smith offers the dedicatory prayer for the Kirtland Temple, given to him by revelation. He asks the Lord to accept the house built through great tribulation, to endow his servants with power, and to gather and prosper Israel, that the Lord's glory may rest upon his people.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The dedicatory prayer for the house of the Lord

chapters.title: Visions in the Kirtland Temple
chapters.synopsis: A week after the dedication, the Savior appears to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in the Kirtland Temple and accepts the house. Moses, Elias, and Elijah then appear in turn, committing the keys of the gathering of Israel, the gospel of Abraham, and the sealing power promised by Malachi.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Joseph and Oliver behold the Lord

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: The Savior accepts his house

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Moses, Elias, and Elijah commit their keys

chapters.title: Treasure More Precious Than Gold
chapters.synopsis: In Salem, Massachusetts, the Lord tells Joseph Smith he is not displeased with the journey despite its follies. There is much treasure in the city for the good of Zion, and many people whom the Lord will gather in due time.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Concern yourselves not; treasure and people in this city

chapters.title: Counsel to the Twelve
chapters.synopsis: Thomas B. Marsh, president of the Twelve Apostles, is counseled to be humble, to pray always, and to admonish the quorum sharply for the Lord's name's sake. Vengeance will begin upon the Lord's house, and the keys of the dispensation stand with the First Presidency.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Be humble; send the Twelve to all nations

chapters.title: Questions on Isaiah Answered
chapters.synopsis: The Lord answers questions about Isaiah's prophecies of the stem, rod, and root of Jesse. Zion is called to put on her strength by returning to the authority of the priesthood and loosing herself from the bands of her neck.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The stem, rod, and root of Jesse explained

chapters.title: A Mission Call for David Patten
chapters.synopsis: David W. Patten is told to settle his business and prepare for a mission the following spring with the Twelve. Offices held by the unfaithful will be given to others.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Prepare for a mission in the spring

chapters.title: The Church Receives Its Name
chapters.synopsis: The Lord names his church The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and commands the saints to arise and shine forth as a standard for the nations. Far West is declared holy ground, and a house is to be built there.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The church named; arise and shine forth

chapters.title: Adam-ondi-Ahman Named
chapters.synopsis: Spring Hill in Daviess County, Missouri, is named Adam-ondi-Ahman by the mouth of the Lord. It is the place where Adam, the Ancient of Days, shall come to visit his people as spoken of by Daniel the prophet.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Spring Hill named Adam-ondi-Ahman

chapters.title: What Is Property unto Me?
chapters.synopsis: William Marks and Newel K. Whitney are commanded to leave their business concerns in Kirtland and gather to Missouri before winter. The Lord asks what property is to him, and Oliver Granger is promised that his name shall be had in sacred remembrance.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Leave Kirtland concerns; gather to the land of Zion

chapters.title: Filling the Quorum of the Twelve
chapters.synopsis: The Lord directs that vacancies in the Twelve be filled, naming John Taylor, John E. Page, Wilford Woodruff, and Willard Richards. The Twelve are to depart from the Far West temple site the next spring to preach over the great waters.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: New apostles named; a mission over the great waters

chapters.title: The Law of Tithing
chapters.synopsis: In answer to Joseph Smith's prayer, the Lord gives the law of tithing: the saints are to pay one-tenth of all their interest annually. This standing law will sanctify the land of Zion, and all who gather there shall observe it.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: One-tenth of all interest annually, a standing law

chapters.title: Disposition of the Tithes
chapters.synopsis: The Lord appoints a council to direct the use of tithed properties. The First Presidency, the bishop and his council, and the high council are to dispose of the tithes by the Lord's own voice unto them.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A council appointed to disburse the tithes

chapters.title: Prayer from Liberty Jail
chapters.synopsis: From the dungeon of Liberty Jail, Joseph Smith cries out, asking how long the Lord's hand will be stayed while his people suffer. The Lord answers with peace, promising that adversity shall be but a small moment, and teaches that the rights of the priesthood operate only upon principles of righteousness, persuasion, and love unfeigned.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: O God, where art thou?

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Peace be unto thy soul; principles of priesthood power

chapters.title: All These Things Give Experience
chapters.synopsis: The Lord assures Joseph Smith in Liberty Jail that though the ends of the earth inquire after his name and fools deride him, the pure in heart will seek his counsel. Even if the very jaws of hell gape after him, all these things shall give him experience and be for his good, for the Son of Man hath descended below them all.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Adversity for thy good; the Son descended below all

chapters.title: Duty Toward Our Persecutors
chapters.synopsis: Continuing the Liberty Jail letter, Joseph Smith declares the saints' duty to gather up and document the sufferings and abuses inflicted upon them. These records are to be presented to the government, and the saints should cheerfully do all things that lie in their power, then stand still to see the salvation of God.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Document the persecutions; cheerfully do all things

chapters.title: Commandments for Nauvoo
chapters.synopsis: At Nauvoo the Lord commands a proclamation to the kings of the earth and the building of the Nauvoo House and a temple where baptisms for the dead and the fulness of the priesthood can be administered. Hyrum Smith is called as patriarch and prophet, and the officers and quorums of the church are set in order.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: A proclamation to kings; Hyrum called as patriarch

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Nauvoo House and the temple with its ordinances

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Officers and quorums of the church set in order

chapters.title: Gathering Places in Iowa
chapters.synopsis: The Lord declares his will concerning the saints in the Territory of Iowa. They are to gather and build up cities unto his name, including a city opposite Nauvoo to be called Zarahemla.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Build up cities in Iowa; Zarahemla named

chapters.title: Your Offering Is Acceptable
chapters.synopsis: Brigham Young is told that his labors in traveling and leaving his family are acceptable to the Lord. He is no longer required to leave home, but is to take special care of his family and send the Lord's word abroad.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Take special care of your family henceforth

chapters.title: An Epistle on Baptism for the Dead
chapters.synopsis: Writing while away from Nauvoo because of his enemies, Joseph Smith glories in tribulation and directs that a recorder witness and record all baptisms for the dead. Whatever is recorded on earth shall be recorded in heaven, that all things may be done in order.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Let a recorder witness the baptisms for the dead

chapters.title: A Welding Link Between Generations
chapters.synopsis: In a second epistle on baptism for the dead, Joseph Smith explains the recorders, witnesses, and books that bind on earth and in heaven. The fathers cannot be made perfect without us, nor we without our dead, forming a welding link between generations, and Joseph exults in the voices of restoration heard from Cumorah to the wilderness.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Records that bind; a welding link with our dead

chapters.title: Discerning Angels and Spirits
chapters.synopsis: Joseph Smith gives three grand keys for discerning heavenly messengers. A resurrected angel will shake hands and be felt, the spirit of a just man made perfect will not move, and a false spirit posing as an angel will offer his hand yet nothing will be felt.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Three grand keys for discerning messengers

chapters.title: Items of Instruction at Ramus
chapters.synopsis: At Ramus, Illinois, Joseph Smith teaches that the Father and the Son have bodies of flesh and bones as tangible as man's. Whatever intelligence we attain in this life rises with us in the resurrection, and all blessings are obtained by obedience to the laws upon which they are predicated.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The Godhead, intelligence, and the law of blessings

chapters.title: The New and Everlasting Covenant
chapters.synopsis: At Ramus, Joseph Smith teaches that in the celestial glory there are three heavens or degrees, and to obtain the highest a man must enter the new and everlasting covenant of marriage. It is impossible to be saved in ignorance, and all spirit is matter more fine and pure.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: Celestial marriage and the degrees of glory

chapters.title: The Eternity of the Marriage Covenant
chapters.synopsis: The Lord reveals the new and everlasting covenant of marriage, by which those sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise continue as husband and wife through eternity and receive exaltation. The revelation cites the example of Abraham and includes instructions concerning Emma Smith.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The everlasting covenant of marriage and exaltation

chapters.title: Go Ye Out from Babylon
chapters.synopsis: In this appendix to the Book of Commandments, the Lord commands the saints to go out from Babylon and prepare for the coming of the Bridegroom. He describes his return in red apparel, the gathering of Israel from the north countries, and the judgments that precede the great and dreadful day.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Prepare for the Bridegroom; Israel gathered from the north

chapters.title: Of Governments and Laws
chapters.synopsis: The church adopts a declaration of belief regarding governments and laws. Governments are instituted of God for the benefit of man, religious opinion should be free from civil constraint, and all people are bound to sustain and uphold their governments while protected in their inherent rights.

segments.speaker: church
segments.note: A declaration of belief on governments and laws

chapters.title: The Martyrdom of Joseph and Hyrum
chapters.synopsis: John Taylor announces the martyrdom of Joseph Smith and his brother Hyrum, shot by a mob in Carthage Jail on June 27, 1844. He testifies that Joseph has done more for the salvation of men in this world than any other who lived in it, save Jesus only, and that he sealed his mission with his blood.

segments.speaker: john-taylor
segments.note: Joseph and Hyrum sealed their testimony with blood

chapters.title: The Word and Will of the Lord
chapters.synopsis: At Winter Quarters the Lord gives his word and will through President Brigham Young concerning the Camp of Israel in its journey to the West. The saints are organized into companies under captains, covenant to walk in all the ordinances of the Lord, and are told to praise him with singing and dancing and to cease to contend one with another.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Camp of Israel organized for the journey west

chapters.title: Vision of the Celestial Kingdom
chapters.synopsis: In the Kirtland Temple, Joseph Smith sees the celestial kingdom, beholding the Father and the Son, Adam, Abraham, and his own parents, and marvels at seeing his brother Alvin there. The voice of the Lord declares that all who would have received the gospel shall be heirs of the celestial kingdom, and that children who die are saved in it.

segments.speaker: joseph-smith
segments.note: The celestial kingdom and Alvin beheld in vision

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Heirs of the celestial kingdom declared

chapters.title: The Redemption of the Dead
chapters.synopsis: Pondering the scriptures on the eve of general conference, President Joseph F. Smith sees a vision of the Savior's ministry in the spirit world. Christ organizes righteous messengers to carry the gospel to the spirits in prison, opening the way for the redemption of the dead through vicarious ordinances.

segments.speaker: joseph-f-smith
segments.note: Pondering the scriptures, the vision opens

segments.speaker: joseph-f-smith
segments.note: The Savior's ministry among the spirits of the dead
